sections.behaviour_description: Choose which links in posts are recorded.
sections.notifications_description: Choose how people are told about new links.
sections.advanced_description: Limits and cleanup. The defaults suit most forums.

settings.enabled_help: When off, new links are not recorded. Existing links are kept.
settings.extract_url_references_help: Record links to other discussions and posts. Links within the same discussion and links inside quotes are ignored.
settings.extract_short_references_help: Record references typed as @"Discussion title"#d123. Type # in the composer to insert one.
settings.extract_mention_references_help: Record mentions of posts in other discussions. Replies within a discussion are ignored. Requires Mentions.
settings.event_post_enabled_label: Announce new links in the discussion
settings.event_post_enabled_help: Add a line like "Alice linked to this discussion from …" to the linked discussion. Only for links from public posts.
settings.max_preview_help: The number of links shown in each list before "View all links".
settings.related_discussions_enabled_help: Show discussions that are often referenced together.
settings.related_discussions_limit_help: The number of related discussions in the sidebar.
settings.related_max_candidates_help: The maximum number of discussions checked to find related ones.
settings.cache_ttl_help: How long related discussions and the graph are cached. 0 disables caching.
settings.graph_max_depth_help: How many steps the graph follows from a discussion.
settings.graph_max_per_hop_help: The maximum number of links the graph follows at each step.
settings.notify_followers_help: Notify users who follow the referenced discussion. Requires Subscriptions.
settings.broken_retention_days_help: How long references to deleted content are kept. 0 keeps them forever.
